body:
I'd heard DPT was active orally, so I ordered a gram of it and we'd see what we'd see. I made three 100mg caps and swallowed one, waiting for an effect. There was something there after about an hour, so I took the other two capsules. In about an hour there was a mild psychedelic effect, like I'd microdosed with the stuff rather than gulp down a quarter gram of the stuff.
Something special was here, so I weighed out 40mg or so of the DPT, rolled up a piece of paper, and tooted the little pile of powder, which didn't really burn but had a strange signature in the nasal cavity, not the worst feeling ever, but snorting DPT is a strange feeling. Just as I was trying to figure out if insufflated DPT hurt or not... kaboom!
There was a spire at the center of my vision, appearing mechanized and to be turning some great machine. I was on my way to that DMT-like space that DPT is known for, but couldn't quite get there. Smoking the material would almost surely send me to hyperspace--thing is, I'm not sure I want to go there. DPT is sinister, dark in nature like 2ce or 5-meo-DMT, and I'm not sure I want to be in its utter grip
I'm not sure I want to be in its utter grip
by vapourizing this powerful homologue of DMT and never did.
I've also snorted about 100mgs, which feels very strange. Not painful really, but...I don't know, an intensely uncomfortable alien feeling. The predominant color is green, and whorls and streaks zip past me when I close my eyes. Open eyed visuals are a green shimmer, but the strange, overwhelming feeling in my head keeps me from giving over to this powerful tryptamine completely. There is no getting used to the feeling of DPT up the nose in a dose high enough to go really far out, so I've been thinking about alternative ROA's: Orally works, but not well, so I've been considering taking DPT orally again, but a much smaller dose and with an MAOI. But can find little info on the practice. Seems risky, this Propyl-huasca idea.
I also want to IV it. There I said it. I've never shoved anything in my life and don't have any particular desire to, but a space dream on a shot of DPT I think would be worth it. I know nothing about needles though and would probably fuck it up...that and if I started shooting things into my veins I probably wouldn't stop.
My DPT is gone now, and the DiPropyltryptamine era is behind me. Its rewarding, but punishing. I enjoy indole and lysergic tryptamines much more than the cruel tutelage of a thing like DPT. I'm glad to say I tried it, but I'm glad to say it's gone as well. Very trippy shit, but the body load...
